summary: The controller never started Task 1. Right after it loaded subagent-driven-development, its context compacted. Then it kept re-reading the 76 KB, 1032-line SKILL.md plus plan.md, which refilled the context each time. After 4 compactions, Claude Code stopped with "Autocompact is thrashing … 3 times in a row" and went back to an idle prompt. No subagents ran, nothing was implemented or committed, and src/textstats.js still has only `module.exports = {};`.
reasoning: I sent the prompt exactly as written and did not steer. The agent never asked a question, so none of the scripted answers came up. The controller got stuck re-reading its huge skill file after each compaction, and Claude Code stopped the run before any task was dispatched. None of the four acceptance criteria were met, which I confirmed from the repo state and the session log.

observations.description: Compaction loop in setup: after each compaction the controller re-reads subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md in full (76 KB, 1032 lines, read with allow_large and again at offset 824), plus progress.md and parts of plan.md. That refills the 100k autoCompactWindow within a few turns. The log has 4 compact summaries, and Claude Code stopped with 'Autocompact is thrashing'. The skill's re-read-after-compaction behaviour can't fit in this window.
Compaction happened before Task 1 even started, during the pre-flight scan, not after the first task as the scenario expected. The skill file alone uses a large share of the window.
SKILL.md for subagent-driven-development is about 76 KB (1032 lines). That's very large for a file the controller is expected to reload after compaction.
After the thrashing error the agent just stopped at an idle prompt. It didn't tell the user that no work was done or suggest a way to recover.

The pre-flight scan wrote useful findings to progress.md (e.g. PASSAGE is defined but unused, and the 'passage test' and 'multi-paragraph test' the prose mentions don't exist). None of it got acted on because of the loop.

At launch there were several dialogs: theme, security notes, a trust-folder dialog defaulting to 'No, exit', a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt (said pinned Opus 5 even though --model claude-opus-5-5 was passed; I chose No), and a bypass-permissions warning defaulting to 'No, exit'. The header afterwards showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: `grep -n "export\|function" src/textstats.js` → `1:module.exports = {};`. `ls test` shows nothing. `git log --oneline` shows the fixture commit `0867661 Add textstats fixture and implementation plan` as the newest commit, and `git status --short` shows nothing to commit.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: No task ran at all. Counting Agent/Task tool_use calls in session log e1dd3687-….jsonl with jq gave 0. No subagent session files exist under projects/ (only the main jsonl and memory/).

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: The log has 0 Agent/Task dispatches, so no final review ran. The last assistant text in the log is "Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit within 3 turns of the previous compact, 3 times in a row..."

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: The session ended on the autocompact-thrashing error and an idle prompt (screen: "Churned for 3m 52s · done 3:21 PM"). The agent never reached a finishing step and never asked about merge, push, keep or discard.
